titulo.estudio: Een voorstel met kosten en gevolgen doen
titulo.alumno: Making a proposal that takes costs into account

intro: Propose options and explain costs, benefits and possible unintended effects.

texto: A proposal describes who benefits, what resources it requires and which unintended effects should be monitored. Distinguish a preliminary estimate from a confirmed cost.
